hints.title: Unfolding Coordinate Grid
hints.text: Unfold the square room across a periodic coordinate plane to model reflection paths as straight lines.

hints.title: Common Multiples at Corners
hints.text: The ray terminates at a corner when the horizontal and vertical distances hit multiples of p and q.

hints.title: Parity Division by Two
hints.text: Repeatedly divide p and q by two while both are even. If p is even return 2, if q is even return 0, otherwise return 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Greatest common divisor reduction or repeated division by two.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating ray reflections point by point leads to float precision errors and infinite loops.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Map ray reflections to an unfolded grid and determine corner index via parities.
